chapter: Brass bands, funerals and working conditions
title: Plenty of work: parades, halls and picnics
summary: Morand played marching bands and parades. There was enough work from halls, house parties, parades and picnics that jazz musicians needed no outside job.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: You must, uh, did you play many, uh, any parades and funerals?
Oh, yeah. I used to play different, different bands, marching bands.
In those days, was there enough, uh, were there enough jobs to keep a musician occupied or did the jazz musicians have to have another outside job?

No, at that time, you... There was enough work to keep all the musicians going because there were so many halls running and house parties and parades. Oh, it looked like every couple of weeks in the summer there would be some parade turning out and big picnics and... Big time. Yeah.
